train.text: pub fn increment_arc_counter(counter: &std::sync::Arc<std::sync::Mutex<u64>>, step: u64) -> Result<u64, &'static str> { let mut guard = counter.lock().map_err(|_| "poisoned")?; *guard += step; Ok(*guard) }

pub fn zero_copy_frame_slice(buf: &[u8]) -> Result<(u32, &[u8]), &'static str> { if buf.len() < 4 { return Err("truncated"); } let hdr = u32::from_be_bytes([buf[0], buf[1], buf[2], buf[3]]); Ok((hdr, &buf[4..])) }
pub struct PinnedDmaSlot<'a> { pub buf: &'a mut [u8] } impl<'a> Drop for PinnedDmaSlot<'a> { fn drop(&mut self) { self.buf.fill(0); } }

holdout.text: pub fn atomic_epoch_tick(cell: &std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64) -> u64 { cell.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst) }
pub fn verify_zero_copy_bounds(slice: &[u8], offset: usize, len: usize) -> Option<&[u8]> { slice.get(offset..offset.checked_add(len)?) }
pub fn lock_free_ring_enqueue<T>(buf: &mut Vec<T>, item: T, cap: usize) -> Result<(), &'static str> { if buf.len() >= cap { return Err("full"); } buf.push(item); Ok(()) }
